te: Flavius Anastasius becomes Byzantine emperor, with the name of Anastasius I.
dz: 弗拉维乌斯·阿纳斯塔修斯成为拜占庭皇帝,取名"阿纳斯塔修斯一世".
de: Flavius Anastasius becomes Byzantine emperor, with the name of Anastasius I.

dz: 阿里阿德涅王后与阿纳斯塔修斯一世结婚. 寡人奥古斯塔能为拜占庭王位选择接班人,后期皇帝泽诺(后期皇帝)死于痢疾后.
de: Empress Ariadne marries Anastasius I. The widowed Augusta is able to choose her successor for the Byzantine throne, after Zeno (late emperor) dies of dysentery.

dz: Odoacer与他的赫鲁利守卫进行夜间攻击,在阿德皮内坦与Theoderic the Great会合. 双方都遭受了沉重的损失,但最终西奥多克力将奥多亚塞尔带回了拉文纳.
de: Odoacer makes a night assault with his Heruli guardsmen, engaging Theoderic the Great in Ad Pinetam. Both sides suffer heavy losses, but in the end Theodoric forces Odoacer back into Ravenna.
